answer: To resist Sybil attacks, we use Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent binds a unique hardware key to a smart contract. Second, they deposit a security bond. Third, the network validates the TPM signature. An attacker trying to flood the digital tundra with fake agents would face a cost of $2,500 in bonds per identity and 14 days of verification time. This prevents a barren mesa of bots from overtaking our digital garden. It is like building a massive, heavy stone wall around a precious flower bed to protect the delicate blooms from a sudden storm.
